describe: The image shows a scene cut-out: a tall silver-grey flagpole with a round finial and a bright red pennant flag at the top. Below is a low orange-brown fortified wall with two dark-capped stone towers on the left and right, and a dark-clad soldier figure at the base right, reaching forward. Transparent background: the grey areas around the objects are transparent. Lighting is flat and cartoon-like with moderate contrast. Keep the flagpole, towers, wall and figure exactly in the same positions.
